item.arsenalatomico.target_marker.tip1: Aim and right-click to launch the selected weapon.
item.arsenalatomico.target_marker.tip2: Press J to choose the weapon.
weapon.arsenalatomico.salvo.desc: A mobile battery fires 24 small missiles that rain down on the target.
weapon.arsenalatomico.icbm.desc: A giant intercontinental missile launched from a concrete silo with alarms. It drops its stages in the sky and the warhead comes back glowing like a meteor.
weapon.arsenalatomico.twin.desc: Two giant intercontinental missiles: from a submarine if there is sea nearby, or from two 8-axle mobile launchers if not.
weapon.arsenalatomico.nuke.desc: The first nuclear bomb: small, but it leaves a giant crater. It comes out of the most detailed bunker: silo, control room, corridor, spiral staircase and guardhouse.
weapon.arsenalatomico.thermo.desc: The most powerful one, and it's a mission: a military truck takes you to the Black Sun Base, you walk down to the command center and press the button yourself.
message.arsenalatomico.not_ready: That weapon is still in development
message.arsenalatomico.busy: A launch is already in progress
